content.text: Collection of blood inside the anterior chamber of the eye
(the space b/n the cornea and the iris); blood may cover most or all of iris/pupil, blocking vision partially or completely; USU
: idiopathic IC HTN, space-occupying lesion (cerebral tumor, abscess), ⇡ CSF prod, cerebral edema, severe HTN (grade IV)
swollen optic disc w/ blurred margins
: MRI/CT (r/o mass effect) ⇢ LP (⇡ CSF P)
MCC permanent legal blindness/vision loss in older adults (esp. >75)
Macula = central part of the retina; controls central vision (reading fine print + facial recognition)
•wet: abnormal vessels beneath the macula leak fluid ⇢ macular edema ⇢ ⇣visual acuity (may be rapid or severe)
•micropsia: obj seem smaller in affected eye
Wet occurs more rapidly & = more severe
– sm, round, yellow-white spots on the outer retina -local deposits of extracell material
- poss gray-green fluid collection in the macular area
- dx confirmed by dilated eye exam w/ slit lamp + OCT
poss slow progression but ⍉ reverse chgs
•combo also incl lutein, zeaxanthin, + Cu (slows dry + wet progression)
